[[Selvetarm]] is a Dryder boss-like foe found at the end of one of the levels of [[Slavers' Exile]]. He is joined by a group of [[Stone Summit]] dwarves, and pairs of [[Shock Phantom]]s, [[Crypt Wraith]]s, and [[Crypt Slasher]]s circle his room. 

When defeated, a [[Chest of the Slaver (Selvetarm)]] appears at his spawn location, and four [[Restless Dead (Eye of the North)|Restless Dead]] (Shadow Prison version) around it.
